svg.title: Pastry Pirates — V2 · The Pixel World — Recipe cards (21)
svg.desc: Every possible 5-of-7 recipe, exactly once — 21 cards, 64x38 mm. Deal two to each captain, keep one, as the app does. Units: mm. 20 mm squares, 3 mm material. RASTER = black fill (engrave), CUT = red hairline (cut). Generated by physical-board/generate.mjs.
